ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Vector [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Vector[/h1] [i]Crisp, animated vector graphics for ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i]
Adds a [b]vector[/b] element: describe a screen once -- shapes, gradients, text, pictures -- and the game draws it as sharp geometry at any size and animates it on your machine. No per-frame Lua, no per-frame network traffic, and a fraction of the cost of a canvas console.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Rounded panels, paths, liquid tanks, waves, charts and particle fields [*] Linear, radial and conic gradients, real transparency, soft and inner shadows [*] Any number can be an expression over time, repeat index or your data, so gauges move smoothly [*] Clipping, scrolling lists, clickable nodes and text in any game font [*] Tessellated on a worker thread: an animated console costs well under 1% of a frame [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds fifteen examples that run on paste, a guide (README.md), a full reference (REFERENCE.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector/tree/main/ScriptedScreensVector]on GitHub[/url]. With StationeersLua installed, AI editors can read and search the same docs through its MCP server.
[h2]What's new in 0.11.27[/h2] [list] [*] Screen captures of data-driven scenes are reliable: no stale text or dark blocks [*] [b]snap = 1[/b] makes a data update apply at once instead of gliding (0.11.26) [*] Multi-colour linear gradients are exact and far lighter (0.11.26) [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector/blob/main/ScriptedScreensVector/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector[/url] (MIT).
